workload.prompt: A sunlit greenhouse filled with orchids and ferns, photographic detail.

method: Four fresh processes ABBA, one warm sample each; cold and separate parity requests excluded; no overlapping GPU experiment
limitations: Only two independent warm samples per arm, one prompt/seed and one machine state
Control is the current library with fusion disabled, not the historical September 7 binary
Denoise timing measures the synchronized pure-GPU pipeline, not summed hardware kernel timestamps
This verifies >=1.5x relative improvement for the tested 1024 workload, not restoration of historical speed
512-under-ten-seconds and historical same-machine regression remain unresolved
Exact file equality is not a separate perceptual-quality or tensor-finiteness audit
